北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感舒适。别忘了多喝水哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and pleasant. Remember to stay hydrated!

宁波.name: 宁波
宁波.ai_briefing_zh: 宁波大雨，湿度高。出门带好雨具，注意安全！
宁波.ai_briefing_en: Ningbo has heavy rain and high humidity. Bring rain gear and stay safe!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海小雨，风力较大。出门带伞，注意保暖别着凉！
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai has light rain and strong winds. Bring an umbrella and stay warm!

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州多云，体感稍热。出门记得防晒补水！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is cloudy and feels warm. Remember sun protection and hydration!
广州.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳多云炎热，体感 34℃。注意防晒多补水！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is cloudy and hot, feels like 34℃. Stay hydrated and use sunblock!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨，风力强劲。带伞添衣，小心着凉！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain and strong winds. Bring an umbrella and dress warmly!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京阴天，风力不小。出门带件薄外套，注意防风！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is overcast with strong winds. Bring a light jacket and mind the wind!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都晴天，体感较热。注意防晒，及时补充水分！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is sunny and feels warm. Remember sun protection and stay hydrated!
成都.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉多云，风力较大。出门注意防风，早晚温差大！
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is cloudy with strong winds. Be mindful of the wind, temperature difference at night!
武汉.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃ | 💨 北风警报：东北风 5级

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感偏热。阳光充足，注意防晒哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and feels warm. Enjoy the sunshine, but remember sun protection!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆多云炎热，体感 33℃。防晒补水，注意休息！
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is cloudy and hot, feels like 33℃. Stay hydrated and rest well!
重庆.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，气温舒适。早晚温差大，别着凉！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny and pleasant. Mind the temperature difference between day and night!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳晴朗，体感舒适。享受阳光，保持好心情！
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is sunny and pleasant. Enjoy the sunshine and keep a good mood!
沈阳.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温4℃

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明阴天，微凉。湿度大，注意衣物防潮哦！
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is overcast and slightly cool. High humidity, mind your clothes!
昆明.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门阴天，风力强劲。出门注意防风，小心着凉！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is overcast with strong winds. Be careful of the wind and don't catch a cold!
厦门.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降5℃

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛阴天，体感偏热。多喝水，注意防晒！
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is overcast and feels warm. Stay hydrated and mind the sun!
青岛.alert: 🟧 橙色降温提示：1小时降温3℃

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，体感舒适。很适合出门走走哦！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy and pleasant. Perfect weather for a stroll!

漳浦.name: 漳浦
漳浦.ai_briefing_zh: 漳浦阴天，风力不小。注意防风，适时增减衣物！
漳浦.ai_briefing_en: Zhangpu is overcast with strong winds. Mind the wind and dress accordingly!
漳浦.alert: 📉 红色降温预警：1小时骤降6℃

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪中雨，湿度高。出门记得带伞，注意防潮！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi has moderate rain and high humidity. Don't forget your umbrella!
